# hiok_container_app_environment (Resource)

A Container App Environment — the shared network apps inside it use to address each other by name, and the boundary that keeps everything else out.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `region` (String)
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `network_name` (String) Docker network backing the environment.
- `status` (String)
